name: Mercenary Meteor Shower
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Meteor Shower (players/wizard/mercenary/meteor_shower_merc.sval, 25 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 3 (in brackets): cooldown 8 s (5 s); mana 180 (160). Its own mana 180 (160), cooldown 8 s (5 s). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Meteor Shower as at level 3 (7 meteors, 320 hybrid) on an 8 s cooldown for 180 mana.
